# Premium Drones Georgia (PDG)

> Premium Drones Georgia sells XAG agricultural drones in Georgia (the country), provides drone crop spraying and spreading services, trains drone operators (PDG Academy) and repairs and services XAG drones. Based in Lagodekhi, Georgia. Working with XAG drones in Georgia since 2022. XAG P150 MAX drones, complete kits, batteries, chargers and original parts are in stock in Georgia; prices are listed in Georgian lari (GEL) on the website.

Contact: +995 550 00 43 33 (phone and WhatsApp), info@premium-drones.ge. Languages: Georgian, English, Russian.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://premium-drones.ge/): overview, P150 MAX key specifications, services, FAQ
- [XAG P150 MAX](https://premium-drones.ge/p150-max): official specifications and all kits with prices in GEL
- [Shop](https://premium-drones.ge/shop): P150 MAX kits, batteries, chargers and spare parts; order by WhatsApp or e-mail
- [About](https://premium-drones.ge/about): company story and services
- [Contact](https://premium-drones.ge/consultation): drone selection, spraying service, training, repair
- English versions: https://premium-drones.ge/en/ ; Russian versions: https://premium-drones.ge/ru/

## Key facts
- XAG P150 MAX: 80 L spray tank, up to 32 L/min with two pumps, 5-10 m spray width, 115 L granule container, 80 kg max payload, IPX6K (official XAG specifications).
- Services: drone spraying and spreading of fields, operator training, diagnostics and repair, original parts.
